title: Installation of the Rear Pressure Bulkhead Outboard Bracket and Segment Root Shear Tie
abstract: Installation of the outboard bracket and the segment root shear tie on the rear pressure bulkhead, including the shim measurement, the sealing of the pressure boundary and the leak check that follows.

sections.purpose: This task installs the outboard bracket and the segment root shear tie on one radial segment of the rear pressure bulkhead, restores the pressure seal and verifies it by a cabin leak check.
sections.job_setup_note: The bulkhead is a pressure boundary and every joint must be sealed wet. Measure the shim gap with the parts held dry before you apply any sealant, and use the shim pack recorded at removal only if the gap has not changed by more than 0.05 millimetres. The sealant has a limited application life once mixed; plan the fastener installation so that the joint is closed inside it.
sections.procedure: 1. Clean the faying surfaces and confirm that the surface protection is continuous. 2. Position the shear tie D5331135070611 dry and measure the gap at four points. 3. Select or make the shim pack and record its thickness on the build sheet. CAUTION: DO NOT STACK MORE THAN THREE LAMINATES IN ONE PACK. A THICKER GAP NEEDS A MACHINED SHIM. 4. Where the lug GIR251836-67 was removed, install it with its own shim pack. 5. Mix the sealant and apply it to the faying surfaces of the shear tie and the bracket D5331131182950. 6. Position the bracket and install the fasteners wet, working from the centre of the pattern outwards. WARNING: DO NOT APPLY FULL TORQUE UNTIL EVERY FASTENER IN THE PATTERN IS FITTED. UNEVEN CLAMP-UP WILL DISTORT THE WEB. 7. Torque the fasteners in the sequence given in the referenced data. 8. Install the clevis pins AGS566056-63 and lock them. 9. Apply the sealant fillet around the full perimeter of the bracket and smooth it. 10. Let the sealant cure for the full period before pressurisation. 11. Do a cabin pressurisation leak check and confirm the leak rate is inside the limit.
sections.close_out: Remove the working platform from the tail cone. Install the ceiling lining in the aft cargo compartment and the cabin lining and monuments in the rear cabin. Confirm from the removal sheet that every fastener has been replaced. Record the shim pack thickness, the sealant batch and the leak check result against the aircraft.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the cabin is depressurised and the outflow valve is locked open until the sealant has cured.
Do not stand on the pressure bulkhead web.
Do not apply full torque before every fastener is fitted.
Wear gloves when you handle mixed sealant.

tooling.description: Torque wrench 20-200 Nm with crowfoot set
